plain.li: {X_nameDef} of the Empire taught me three different bows. I've already forgotten which one is for a baron.
Heard all about the imperial court from {X_nameDef}. Nine-day feasts. I'd settle for one good dinner.
The Empire has a title for everything. {X_nameDef} says even the titles have titles.
[lowtech] {X_nameDef} talks about ships between the stars as if they were carts. I nodded as if I understood.

warm.li: {X_nameDef} was patient with all my questions about the Empire. I liked {X_objective} more than I expected to.

blunt.li: Imperial visitor. Lots of manners. Ate well, though.

cheerful.li: I practiced my imperial bow on the chickens all afternoon. They were not impressed.

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} talks about the Empire as if it will last forever. Nothing does.

cold.li: Got {X_nameDef} to explain who outranks whom in the Empire. I wrote it all down.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} explained the republic's senate to me. As far as I can tell, everyone votes and the grain merchants win.
{X_nameDef} drew an arch in the dirt and showed me why it stands. I've been looking at our doorways differently all day.
[skill:Construction] Mortar with volcanic ash, according to {X_nameDef}. I need to find out where the nearest volcano is.

warm.li: {X_nameDef} said our council reminded {X_objective} of the republic in its good days. I think it was meant kindly.

blunt.li: The republic's visitor thinks too much of the republic. Good builders, though.

cheerful.li: The republic has a forum where anyone can make a speech! I've been practicing mine.

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef} says the republic was free once, before the old families bought it. Everything gets bought, sooner or later.

cold.li: {X_nameDef}'s people value order and good stonework. Easy neighbors to deal with, if we keep the paperwork straight.

plain.li: {X_nameDef} says {X_pronoun} drove two hundred cattle across the salt flats on one canteen. I believe about half of that.
Tasted the settlers' chemshine. My throat is still warm.
[skill:Animals] Caught a goat with a rope today, the way {X_nameDef} showed me. Only took forty throws.
{X_nameDef} told me about a bandit who got hired to guard the stagecoach he kept robbing. Settlers are strange people.

warm.li: {X_nameDef} was good company. Loud, a liar in every story, and good company.

blunt.li: The settler talks too much. Knows horses, though.

cheerful.li: I'm going to learn to throw a rope like {X_nameDef}! No fence post is safe.

gloomy.li: {X_nameDef}'s stories all have the same ending: somebody ends up in the dirt. I suppose that's the frontier.

cold.li: The settlers trade fairly and drink hard. Useful to know both.
